The system also supports FATF (Financial Action Task Force) standards for cross-border transfers, ensuring traceability while protecƟng user anonymity through pseudonymized addresses. Decentralized Identity Verification for Fraud Reduction: Fraud, such as fake client profiles or payment disputes in global gig platforms (e.g., Fiverr or local equivalents), is mitigated via Decentralized Identity (DID) systems.
